skills.name: Cross-sections

steps.d: of a cube at odd angles

skills.wrong_turn: A slanted slice of a cylinder is an ellipse, not a circle. And a slice of a cube need not be a square.
skills.rule: A cross-section is the flat shape where a plane cuts a solid.

skills.name: Solids of revolution
skills.wrong_turn: The radius is the distance from the axis. A 3-by-4 rectangle spun about a side of length 4 has radius 3, height 4.
skills.rule: Rotating a flat region about a line sweeps out a solid of revolution.

skills.name: Cavalieri's principle

steps.d: sphere from a cylinder minus a cone

skills.wrong_turn: For a slanted prism or cylinder, use the perpendicular height, not the length of the slanted side.
skills.rule: Solids with equal cross-section areas at every height have equal volumes.

skills.name: Surface area of pyramids & cones
skills.wrong_turn: Lateral area uses the slant height, not the height. For r = 3, h = 4 it is π·3·5, not π·3·4.

skills.name: Surface area of spheres
skills.wrong_turn: A sphere's area is 4πr², not 4πr³ or (4/3)πr³. Area is squared units; volume is cubed.

skills.name: Volume of pyramids & cones
skills.wrong_turn: A cone is one third of the cylinder with the same base and height, not one half.

skills.name: Composite solids
skills.wrong_turn: When pieces are joined, don't count hidden faces. A cone on a cylinder hides the cylinder's top and the cone's base.
skills.rule: Volume: add the parts, subtract the holes. Surface area: count only the outside.

skills.name: Density & design
skills.wrong_turn: Density is mass divided by volume, not volume divided by mass. Water is 1 g per cm³.
